estimates.assumptions: Standard garlic clove is ~3g each when peeled and sliced; 2 cloves total 6g edible portion.
Average medium red chili pepper is ~45g whole; edible sliced portion after removing stem is nearly the full weight.
Measurement given as 75g; typical frozen green peas are ~81 kcal/100g.
'Bunch' of coriander (cilantro) estimated at 20g usable chopped leaves for a standard supermarket bunch; stems often partially discarded.
'To serve' hot sauce is a modest per-person drizzle; 5g total estimate across the recipe (modest seasoning amount).
